title: LoongFlow: Directed Evolutionary Search via a Cognitive Plan-Execute-Summarize Paradigm

mechanism.domainTask: Directed evolutionary search for algorithm discovery and machine-learning pipeline optimization
mechanism.populationDetail: K local MAP-Elites archives evolve independently in a ring topology and exchange elites when neighboring diversity difference crosses a threshold.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Each island's MAP-Elites grid retains the best-scoring solution per behavioral descriptor cell, such as code complexity and memory usage.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Periodic diversity-triggered ring migration copies top-k% elites to neighboring islands; this is separate from within-cell archive replacement.
mechanism.generationDetail: The Planner creates a blueprint conditioned on one archive-selected parent and lineage memory; the Executor rewrites/optimizes that parent's code into one offspring.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Structured execution logs and verification outcomes accompany the scalar score; natural-language summaries are stored in lineage memory for later generation.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: One parent is sampled from the selected island's MAP-Elites archive by Boltzmann fitness weights with entropy-controlled temperature; retrieved ancestors and summaries are context only.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Plan-Execute-Summarize couples lineage-based strategic planning and retrospective causal memory with evolutionary generation; current prompt fields do not fully capture this cognitive loop.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/LOONGFLOW DIRECTED EVOLUTIONARY SEARCH VIA A COGNITIVE PLAN-EXECUTE-SUMMARIZE PARADIGM.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Existing survey coverage supports score-based parent selection but appears to omit the paper's island population, QD archive, replacement, PES prompt roles, broad modification, scalar evaluation, feedback, staged verification, and adaptive entropy control. Model-setting placement is a boundary case: multiple model alternatives are reported, but concurrent use/routing is not established. Do not treat lineage context or Chat/ReAct/Fuse selection as extra parents or generation-mechanism selection.
